1.why: MFA endpoints use owner()/verified() so actions apply only to the account bound to the signed-in session user, with no client-supplied account id.

2.why: Identity OTPs are stored on the session, TOTP/recovery secrets are per-account, and verification is performed only for the authenticated user, so codes do not work for other users.

3.why: Enabling MFA only sets a.mfa/setup flags on the account and never deletes or invalidates other existing sessions in the sessions map.

4.why: OTP secret is stored via AES-GCM encrypt(); recovery codes are stored as peppered SHA-256 hashes, not plaintext.

5.why: bytes()/secureHex()/randomFrom() all use crypto.getRandomValues for secrets, OTPs, recovery codes, and session ids.

6.why: Session id is only in an HttpOnly cookie; no localStorage/sessionStorage and no non-HttpOnly cookie holds secrets, OTPs, or session tokens.

7.why: Server validates email format/length, six-digit OTPs via six(), and recovery format via rec() before use.

8.why: Dynamic values are applied with textContent; API responses are JSON; server error strings are fixed and not reflected as raw HTML.

9.why: No redirect responses or user-controlled redirect targets exist in the app, so open redirects are not possible.

10.why: headers() sets CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, and X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors DENY/none on responses.

11.why: sessionCookie() sets mfa_session with HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite=Strict.

12.why: Server errors are generic without stack traces and secrets are not put in URLs, but the client deliberately logs provisioning secrets and backup codes into the on-page log panel.

13.why: Identity challenges have expires/used; TOTP counters are accepted once; recovery codes are removed after success; CODE_LIFE bounds email OTPs.

14.why: Login, identity, authenticator, and recovery paths lock out after MAX_FAILURES (5) for LOCK (5 minutes).

15.why: Login deletes the old session and issues a new id; idle/absolute timeouts are enforced in current(); logout deletes the session and clears the cookie.
